changelog:
0.3.42
- Fix: after unlocking at startup or after a Brain session, the Brain list could take a few seconds longer to appear than after "Lock now". The Membrane now checks which Brains are online while the lock screen is up, so the list shows as soon as you unlock.

0.3.41
- Settings > Changelog: once an update is found, you can now check again for an even newer one instead of only being able to apply the one already found (github.com/mulai/slimeos#35).

0.3.40
- Fix: opening Settings could take a few seconds before the panel appeared. The Internet tab was asking for the active Wi-Fi network in a way that could trigger a fresh scan; it now reads it without touching the radio (github.com/mulai/slimeos#34).

0.3.39
- Fix: unlocking with the recovery PIN could take several seconds. It now checks in well under a second (github.com/mulai/slimeos#33).

0.3.38
- "Faster (beta)" Brain connection now also sends the Membrane's replies to the Brain over the faster path, not just the picture and sound coming back, so video keeps up better on busy or patchy Wi-Fi. FreeRDP build +slimeos11, installed during this update's restart.

0.3.37
- Fix: the Settings panel no longer resizes and re-centers itself every time you switch between a short page and a tall one — it now stays the same size, with a scrollbar for pages that don't fit (github.com/mulai/slimeos#29).

0.3.36
- "Faster" Brain connection (Settings > Display & Sound) is now on by default on devices that support it, after several days of steady daily use. It still switches back to Standard on its own if it ever stops working mid-session.

0.3.35
- Smoother Brain sessions on Wi-Fi: the Membrane now turns off Wi-Fi power saving, which could add short delays to the picture and to typing and mouse movement.

0.3.34
- Settings is easier to get around: the left side now has four categories (Network, Display & Devices, Security & Privacy, System), and each category's pages are tabs across the top, so the list no longer needs scrolling on small screens (github.com/mulai/slimeos#22).

0.3.33
- Fix: SSH access set up from the installer USB's Rescue mode (for a Membrane that's otherwise unreachable) no longer stops working after the next restart. It now uses its own account. Remote Support is unchanged: it still turns itself off at every restart, and Settings shows it as on only when you turned it on.

0.3.32
- Fix: Remote Support could show as on while nobody could connect. A startup race could leave the Membrane's firewall half-loaded; it now starts up in order, repairs itself if needed, and Remote Support reports an error instead of showing connection details that don't work.

0.3.31
- Maintenance: clearer update logs from hardware detection. Devices installed before 0.3.14 have a new one-time repair tool (membrane/tools/retrofit-update-helper.sh) so hardware-profile and FreeRDP updates apply to them too.

0.3.30
- Fix: reconnecting to a cloud Brain within a few seconds of disconnecting could open the Brain in a quarter-sized screen. The Membrane now waits ("Finishing your last session…") until the Brain has closed the previous session, usually about 10 seconds (github.com/mulai/slimeos#17).

0.3.29
- Fix: with Brain connection set to Faster, disconnecting could crash the connection on some devices, so the Membrane reconnected instead of returning to the Brain list. FreeRDP build +slimeos9, installed during this update's restart.

0.3.28
- Intel NUC6CAxx (Celeron J3455) devices now decode the Brain's video on the built-in graphics chip (VAAPI) instead of the CPU, for much smoother playback. Other devices keep decoding in software until each one is tested.
- FreeRDP build +slimeos8: adds the opt-in hardware decode. It installs during this update's restart.

0.3.27
- New: "Brain connection" in Settings > Display & Sound. "Faster (beta)" sends the Brain's picture and sound over UDP, which keeps video much smoother on weak or busy Wi-Fi. If UDP stops working mid-session, the Membrane reconnects over the standard connection on its own within a few seconds. Off by default.
- FreeRDP is now updated over the air like everything else (new build +slimeos7: the camera and keyboard fixes plus the UDP transport). It installs during this update's restart.

0.3.26
- Lock screen: locks automatically after 1, 5 (default), 15 or 30 minutes idle on the Brain list or in Settings, or never (Settings > Security > Lock Screen).
- New: name this Membrane (same tab). The name shows when you approve an unlock or sign-in on your phone, and in your Slime ID device list.

0.3.25
- Lock screen now opens on the recovery PIN, like Windows and macOS. Tap "Unlock with phone" to show a QR code instead; no unlock code is requested until you do.

0.3.24
- New: optional lock screen (Settings > Security > Lock Screen, needs Slime ID). When on, the Membrane locks at startup, after every Brain session, and from the new padlock icon. Unlock by scanning a QR code with your phone (only your own Slime ID can approve it), or with the recovery PIN shown at install, which also works offline. Wrong PINs are rate-limited.

0.3.23
- Settings > Remote Support now says plainly that the support team has full control of the device while Remote Support is on.

0.3.22
- Security: the recovery PIN is no longer kept in a readable file on the device after it has been shown once.

0.3.21
- Fix: Settings > Remote Support keeps showing the access details (host, user, password) after you switch tabs or close and reopen Settings, instead of losing them while Remote Support stays on. If they can’t be shown (after the Membrane restarts its session), the screen now says to turn it off and on for a new password.

0.3.20
- Fix: the "Technical details" section on connection-error screens now opens with a normal mouse click; previously it could only be opened by clicking elsewhere and pressing Space.

0.3.19
- Fix: lowered the RDP audio playback buffer (~200ms -> ~100ms) to fix audio lagging behind video on Brains with hardware-accelerated (NVENC) video — the old buffer was tuned when video was still software-encoded and slower, so it went unnoticed until video sped up.

0.3.18
- Fix: Settings > Changelog only shows the notes for the version actually installed (or, for a pending update, the version being installed), instead of every past release's notes concatenated together (github.com/mulai/slimeos#16).

0.3.17
- Fix: a Windows Brain reconnecting to its own previous disconnected RDP session (instead of a fresh one) could leave the Membrane stuck showing a quarter-size Brain picker until the whole Brain was rebooted — the hub now force-clears the stale session right after every clean disconnect (github.com/mulai/slimeos#17).
- Fix: NUC6CAxx (Celeron J3455) devices get a new dedicated hardware profile that switches to /gfx:AVC420 — xfreerdp3's AVC444 decode is single-threaded and was the real cause of choppy video playback on this board, not network or aggregate CPU (github.com/mulai/slimeos#14). Only shipped once #17 above was fixed, since switching codecs mid-session is exactly the kind of resize that could trigger it.

0.3.16
- New: "Brain display scaling" control in Settings > Display & Sound — fixes a large TV/monitor rendering a native-DPI desktop stretched across the whole screen (tiny icons/text), since Windows won't let you change Display settings from inside an RDP session itself (github.com/mulai/slimeos#15).

0.3.15
- Fix: capped the ALSA playback buffer used for Brain audio redirection, instead of letting FreeRDP request the hardware's maximum (up to ~11s on some onboard audio codecs) — stops residual audio lingering after stopping or adjusting volume on the Brain (github.com/mulai/slimeos#12).

0.3.14
- Fix: FreeRDP sessions now enable auto-reconnect globally, and profile 008 (Gigabyte 78LMT-S2P) falls back to /rfx, so a WiFi blip resumes the session instead of dropping it (github.com/mulai/slimeos#11).
- hardware-profiles/*.sh and detect.sh are now updated over-the-air like every other file, instead of requiring a reinstall.
